items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: A fella by the name of Eddie Gilmore played the bass. And I played the band?

ctx.x: Clarinet, guitar and bass. And who were they? A fella by the name of Eddie Gilmore played the bass. And I played the band? And a fella by the name of Al Seed, I don't know his last name, I forgot his last name, but he played the clarinet. And Papa Dad played the guitar.
